18. REMOVE AIR TUBES AND INTAKE AIR CONNECTOR
(a) Disconnect the connector and hoses:
(1) Crankshaft position sensor connector from clamp
(2) Water bypass hose (from water pump) from No.1 turbo water pipe
(3) Water bypass hose (from water outlet) from No.1 turbo water pipe
(4) Water bypass hose (from water outlet) from No.2 turbo water pipe
(b) Remove the bolt, and disconnect the No.2 turbo water pipe from the No.4 air tube.
